“Indian economy is dead.”
“Rupee all-time low.”
“Foreign investors are leaving.”

You’ve heard the headlines. But what’s the real story?

In this video, we cut through the noise and propaganda to look at India’s actual macro fundamentals. From clean energy and solar adoption to manufacturing, exports, railways, ports, and infrastructure—India is quietly building strength where it actually matters.

We also simplify the falling rupee debate, IMF ratings, and foreign investment panic, and explain why these don’t automatically mean economic failure. This is not blind optimism, and it’s not government PR—it’s a data-backed reality check.

India still has gaps: education reforms, R&D spending, future tech like semiconductors and AI. But calling the economy “dead” ignores what’s clearly working.

Watch till the end before forming an opinion.
